data.text: The second half of KAD-45 - refreshing the snapshot after a write - is not a small change. project() is not a left fold: phase one seeds every entity up front because an entity can merge after the events that refer to it (I2, ADR-013), documents fold after the loop from a revision list the state does not carry, and labels are assigned during folding. Applying one event to a folded state needs an apply() that is provably equivalent to a full fold, with I1 at stake. Rebuilding eagerly after each write is not a shortcut: it just moves the cost from the read to the write and makes a write-heavy loop worse.
